resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Ukrainian source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review checks, typecheck, complete build, route and generated-link checks, and the full test suite passed after the cycle was finalized.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Ukrainian pass identified eleven remaining trigonometry, circuit, and imperial-unit terminology defects; all eleven were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Ukrainian human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The Ukrainian right-triangle formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The formulas used opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse instead of Ukrainian side terminology.
findings.resolution: Localized all three side labels in the formulas.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas retained English side labels.
evidence: The previous expressions contained opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse.
findings.resolution: Localized the side labels while preserving inverse-function notation.

findings.summary: The series-cell formula retained the English word series in a Ukrainian annotation.
The parallel-branch voltage formula retained an English annotation.
evidence: The previous expression ended with (parallel branches).

findings.summary: The inch conversion retained the English unit name and notation.
evidence: The previous formula began 1 inch = 25.4 mm = 0.0254 m in a Ukrainian section.
findings.resolution: Localized the unit names and decimal separators.

findings.summary: The foot conversion retained English unit names and notation.
evidence: The previous formula used foot and inches in English.
findings.resolution: Localized the unit names and decimal separators.

findings.summary: The yard conversion retained English unit names and notation.
evidence: The previous formula used yard and feet in English.
findings.resolution: Localized the unit names and decimal separators.

findings.summary: The right-triangle section mixed Ukrainian prose with English formula terminology.
evidence: The paragraph defined Ukrainian side terms while the displayed formulas retained English labels.
findings.resolution: Aligned all displayed ratios with the Ukrainian explanation.

findings.summary: The angle-finding section was inconsistent across inverse formulas and the surrounding Ukrainian prose.
evidence: The inverse formulas did not reuse the Ukrainian side terminology from the preceding explanation.
findings.resolution: Applied one consistent Ukrainian terminology set throughout the section.

findings.summary: The imperial-length subsection mixed Ukrainian and English unit naming.
evidence: The inch, foot, and yard formulas were still presented in English notation.
findings.resolution: Normalized the three length conversions to Ukrainian unit names and separators.

findings.summary: The parallel-branch annotation was the remaining English label in the circuit formulas.
evidence: The surrounding Ukrainian voltage-law section used Ukrainian terminology while this annotation remained English.
findings.resolution: Changed the annotation to паралельні гілки.
